sn47.30:1.1: Taṃ yeva nidānaṃ || || Tena kho pana samayena Mānadinno gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 3--6. Atha kho Mānadinno gahapati aññataram purisam āmantesi || pe || || Evarūpāya cāham bhante dukkhāya vedanāya puṭṭho samāno kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Yānicimāni bhante Bhagavatā pañcorambhāgiyani saṃyojanāni desitāni || nāham bhante yaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmīti || || Lābhā te gahapati || suladdhan te gahapati || anāgāmiphalaṃ tayā gahapati vyākatan ti || || Sīlavaggo tatiyo || ||
sn47.30:2.0: Tassa uddānam || || Sīlaṃ Ṭhiti Parihānam Suddhakaṃ || Brāhmaṇena ca Padesam || Samattam Loko ca Sirivaḍḍho || Mānadinnena te dasā ti
